notes.title: Dark forest in Delares!
notes.notes:
The [b]Dark Forest [/b]is a Delares biome, in which darkness always reigns. To survive in it, you'll have to find and tame a fairy to light your way.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UUt2JDg.gif[/img]

The forest is teeming with [b]spiders[/b] that try to kill you. The abundance of trees makes fighting them problematic. With no space for range attacks you’re forced to battle them up close and personal. But beware of their sticky webs. They spit out webballs that slow your movement and make battling them even more difficult.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CbV2Fxp.gif[/img]

A [b]spider nest[/b] will be one of the most difficult locations to pass. With spiders continuously spawning, battling them can be futile. You will either want to sneak past the group or destroy the nest entirely.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Y4T5xKC.gif[/img]

These web-tossing-baddies can be tamed if you're brave enough to feed them meat. A tamed spider will aid you in battle, but these now loyal beasts don’t have much health or deal as much damage.

[b]Zombie moles[/b] also dwell in the dark forest. These slow moving and untamable animals aren’t normally much of a challenge to avoid but become a much more formidable enemy when a mob of them surrounds you. With such low health their technique is to overwhelm you.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3ndWq0O.gif[/img]

Another inhabitant of the dark forest is the [b]magic golem[/b]. But we’ll keep their secrets a little longer and tell you more about this creature in a future update.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3unbHLU.gif[/img]

That's all for now! ːsteamhappyː
Add the game to your wishlist and sign up for blog updates! See you in Delares!

notes.title: Delares armor system preview
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=7rEhBTeGPuk;full][/previewyoutube]
We are working on equipment system and armor mechanics in Delares.

The armor will not have dense durability, there will be some amount of capsules that are spent when taking damage.If all capsules are used, the armor breaks.

Each piece of armor will have its own statistics - the number of capsules, damage absorption factor and minimum damage that need to break armor.(After all, it will be wrong if armor breaks from a hit for 1 damage, right?)

Also in the game you can find types of armor that are restores automatically, right in battle.
And many more interesting content awaits you in [b]Delares[/b]!
